product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Sweed Valley Farmhouse Pouf 17.5 x 20.25, Light Brown and Black
features: CASUAL POUF OTTOMAN: Modern and fresh with just a hint of farmhouse flair—how appealing. This pouf is sure to add a homey touch to your room's decor
COZY FEEL: Stuffed with dense, shape-retaining polystyrene bead filling and wrapped in a jute/cotton blend cover with zipper closure. For best care, spot clean only
RUSTIC CHIC STYLE: The two-tone light brown and black color palette speaks volumes with its braided design and stylish stitching
GREAT FOR SMALL SPACES: Measuring 17.5” W x 20.25” D x 17.75” H, this pouf is a great fit in any trendy adult space
INSTANT STYLE: Add a plush pouf and poof, you've instantly transformed your space
description: Natural beauty is always in vogue, and this pouf proves it. Braided design in natural jute and gray is simple yet fresh. Stylish stitching and dense filling hold the look together. Once a trend and now a decorating staple, poufs are versatile pieces that everyone can experiment with in their home. This workhorse piece has a variety of uses, from extra seating to simply serving as a decorative accent. You can find your perfect pouf through our range of special prints and patterns. And we go the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner.
